{{nihongo|'''Mishima Shrine'''|三島神社 (南伊豆町下小野)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Mishima Shrine''' (みしまじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Shimoono, {{ill|Minamiizu|Q1203741|qid=Q1203741}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|Q961511|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401111 三島神社] - Shizuoka Prefectural Shrine Office</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined on the northern mountain foot along {{ill|Shizuoka Prefectural Road Route 121|Q11663280|qid=Q11663280|lt=Route 121}} in the Shimoono district on the upper Aono River in northern Minamiizu.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Ametsukatahime-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (あめつかたひめのみことじんじゃ), and is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Ametsukatahime no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/misima8_title.htm 三島神社] - Genbu</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140130-01.html 三島神社] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was ranked as a gōsha<ref name="engi"/>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Ametsukatahime-no-Mikoto (あめつかたひめのみこと)
